displayName: Keep Your CRM Up to Date
summary: Turn approved emails, meetings, and sales activity into reviewable CRM updates.

useCases.title: Keep my CRM up to date
useCases.message: Help me keep my CRM current from recent emails, meetings, and sales activity. Use the CRM and context already available, then show me a small set of proposed updates with their sources so I can correct the mapping before anything changes.
